# dsh-web-notify

## 中文

- 🔔 **桌面通知**：回合完成、出现提问 / 计划评审 / 权限批准时弹出系统通知，点击切回窗口
- 🔊 **提示音**：柔和的双音提示（Web Audio）
- ⚡ **标题闪烁**：页面在后台

## English
System-level attention alerts for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI:
- 🔔 Desktop notifications on turn completion, pending questions, plan reviews and approval requests;

click to focus the window
- 🔊 A soft two-tone chime (Web Audio)
- ⚡ Tab-title flashing while the pa

ge is hidden
- 🩺 A self-test chip (bottom-right 🔔) that fires a test notification + chime on click
-
🧠 Attentive triggering: alerts only when you are not already watching the session (page hidden, win
dow unfocused, or a non-active session finished)
